articles.author: Caspian Grey
articles.description:
Hi, I’m Caspian Grey.
I’m starting this blog for a simple reason: I want to learn in public.
For a long time, I tried learning JavaScript, web development, and computer science in silence - watching tutorials, reading docs, taking notes. But I realized something important:
You learn fastest when you teach.
So this blog marks the beginning of my journey as a developer, teacher, and creator. Not an expert. Not a guru.
What you can expect from this blog?
I’ll be documenting everything I learn about:
JavaScript fundamentals
But I won’t write in a “textbook” style.
I’ll write the way I understand things: Clear, simple, practical, conversational.
If I struggle with a concept, I’ll write about that too.
My goal is not to show “how much I know,” but to teach the way I wish someone had taught me.
Why I chose to teach while learning?
Because teaching forces clarity. Speaking forces courage. Sharing forces consistency.
It strengthens:
Communication
And that’s exactly what I want to build - a calm, confident, clear communicator who can explain code simply.
Who is Caspian Grey?
It’s the identity I’m building for myself:
Calm
This name represents the version of me I’m becoming —
What’s next?
I’ll start sharing:
Short lessons
You’ll see my progress in real-time - from basics to advanced.
This is just the beginning.
(Caspian Grey)
articles.title: Intro Blog: “A New Beginning - Learning, Teaching, and Building as Caspian Grey”
